conclusion: Both lines coincide (+-1 px) with the tile seams of the two layers with parallax<1; the sky behind shows through a 1 logical px gap. Not present in atlas textures (column scan) nor in 03's own composition/Godot capture.
cam_x_independent: battle.gd clamps _cam_x >= -90 + vw/2 = 230 at round start (hero near base) -> predicted far 285.5, mid 216.5 logical; observed 285, 216
root_cause: battle_view.gd _draw_biome_layers draws each copy at roundf(x) independently. off = 230*0.85 = 195.5 (far) and 230*0.55 = 126.5 (mid) are exact .5 values; roundf rounds half away from zero, so roundf(-444.5) = -445 but roundf(195.5) = 196 -> copies 641 px apart -> 1 logical px gap (2 device px at 2x) that reveals the sky strip behind. ground (parallax 1.0, off = 0) has no gap, consistent with no line there.
suggested_fix_02: round once per layer: var bx := floorf(x0 + 0.5) (or floorf(x0)); draw copies at bx + k*tile_w (integer steps). Acceptance: same capture (r01, t=5s, secondary monitor) has 0 isolated pale columns; also test cam_x values giving .5 offsets.
